name: com.hyperwallet.android.ui.transfer.view.ListTransferDestinationActivity
description: During a Hyperwallet transfer, this screen lists available receiving methods for the selected source. Choosing one returns it to the transfer flow, and the screen can also open the method-selection screen to add a new destination.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose or add a receiving method while creating a Hyperwallet transfer.
